prompt.generated_prompt_string: A clearly adult blonde woman with a chin-length bob in soft voluminous waves and a slight middle part, elegant understated neutral makeup complementing a fair complexion, poised direct expression, and natural dewy skin texture. She wears a black satin mini dress with an asymmetrical one-shoulder silhouette, dramatic ruffled puff on the left shoulder, gathered ruffled neckline, textured satin finish, and classic black open-toe platform heels. Show a confident full-body red-carpet stance with relaxed arms and natural weight shift against a textured deep teal blue step-and-repeat backdrop at a fictional professional media event. Use soft professional event lighting with controlled flash fill, approximately 4800K, soft highlights on satin and hair, gentle facial modeling, an 85mm portrait lens, realistic skin texture, restrained teal-and-black grade, accurate satin reflection, subtle grain, and an optional close-up crop. Use an approved generic adult model rather than a public-figure likeness.
